model.name: projection.register
model.description: Register a view format as a PROJECTION {selects, render}: generate-sprint-md = projection #1; the MDA/trace tree, detail drawers, overview each register. On UNIT_CHANGED the pipeline invokes ONLY the AFFECTED projections (by selects), scoped + debounced. Adding a format is REGISTRATION ONLY — zero bus/pipeline edits (DRY).
